name: MIZUNASHI ARATA
source:
"Ahahahaha! ARATA MIZUNASHI here! The world's greatest programmer! I'll hack despair and death themselves... Just kidding! Heeheehee!!!"

A mysterious figure who goes by the name ARATA MIZUNASHI. It'd be improper to say too much about him just yet.

He created the Glitch Girls, and he schemes to destroy the world.

His true identity and goals remain unclear, but beneath his carefree facade, he hides a deep, burning rage. A dangerous man who doesn't pull his punches—approach with extreme caution!

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category9&ch=mizunashi]official website[/url]]
